exposure: tailored intervention on Infant and Young Child Feeding (IYCF) practices
outcome: knowledge and practice of diet during pregnancy
complementary food items, consistency and frequency of feeding
cohort: The study included 351 mothers of children under three years of age and 87 antenatal women, along with influencers, selected from 12 of 16 wards in a self-administration area.
finding: The tailored intervention significantly increased knowledge regarding breastfeeding initiation, exclusive breastfeeding, and bottle feeding, and led to a significant decline in prelacteal feeds among respondents and influencers.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was cited by 84.5% of mothers as a reason for non-initiation of breastfeeding.
